headline: U.S. Payrolls Rose by 165,000 in October
deck: The October employment report showed a 165,000 payroll gain and a 4.1% unemployment rate.
body: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics said total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 165,000 in October. Local News Live also reported the seasonally adjusted gain, citing the bureau. [E1] [E4]
The unemployment rate was 4.1%, and 7.1 million people were unemployed; both changed little in October, the bureau said. [E2]
Employment increased in professional and business services, health care, and transportation and warehousing. [E3]
